title: Pittsburgh Steelers at Cincinnati Bengals best prop bets for Thursday Night Football - NewsBreak
text:
By Jess Root ,
17 minutes ago Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase (1) reacts after scoring a touchdown in the fourth quarter against the Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field in Green Bay, Wisconsin. By Kayla Wolf, Kayla Wolf-Imagn Images
The Pittsburgh Steelers (4-1) visit the Cincinnati Bengals (2-4) Thursday night to open Week 7 in the NFL. Kickoff from Paycor Stadium in Cincinnati, Ohio, is at 8:15 p.m. ET (Prime Video). Let's analyze BetMGM Sportsbook's Steelers vs. Bengals odds and tab the 5 best prop bets to win among SportsbookWire's expert NFL picks and predictions for Week 1.
The Steelers have won 3 games in a row and are coming off a 23-9 home win over the Cleveland Browns as 6-point favorites with the Under (38.5) cashing. QB Aaron Rodgers threw 2 TD passes in the win and has 10 TD passes through 5 games.
The Bengals have lost 4 straight games after a 2-0 start, all since they lost QB Joe Burrow for at least 3 months to a toe injury. Days after acquiring QB Joe Flacco from the Browns, the Bengals covered the 15-point spread in a 27-18 road loss to the Green Bay Packers on Sunday. The total (45) was a push. Flacco had 2 TD passes in the loss.
The AFC North rivals split last season with each team winning on the road. The Steelers won 44-38 in Week 13 and the Bengals won 19-17 in Week 18.

Best Steelers at Bengals prop bets Odds provided by BetMGM Sportsbook ; access USA TODAY Sports Scores and Sports Betting Odds hub for a full list. Lines last updated at 12:08 a.m. ET.
Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase OVER 74.5 RECEIVING YARDS (-118) Chase had only 73 combined receiving yards in the first 2 games after Burrow's injury. However, he has had 110 and 94 yards, scoring at least 1 TD in the last 2 games. Flacco targeted him 12 times on Sunday, and he hauled in 10 (Over 6.5 receptions at -130 is a reasonable prop as well).
Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase ANYTIME TD (+140) Flacco is going to look for Chase as often as he can. Chase has 3 TDs in his last 2 games. If the Bengals find the end zone, a Chase TD makes the most sense.
STEELERS AT BENGALS: Odds, picks and predictions Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers OVER 0.5 INTERCEPTIONS THROWN (+115) Rodgers has not thrown an interception in his last 2 games, but has thrown picks in 2 of 5 games this season. The Bengals have 7 takeaways in 6 games and 6 are interceptions. The plus odds make this bet juicy.
Bengals K Evan McPherson OVER 1.5 FG MADE (-105) Normally, plus odds on kicking props are the way to go, but -105 odds are close to even money. McPherson has made exactly 1 FG in all 6 games this season, but he had 6 games (out of 12 he played) with at least 2 made field goals in 2024. The Steelers have allowed 2+ FGs in 2 games this season.
Steelers RB Jaylen Warren OVER 50.5 RUSHING YARDS (-115) Warren had a season-high 52 yards on Sunday against the Browns, and he has only averaged 3.4 yards per attempt so far this season. However, the Bengals are 28th in the league in rushing yards allowed, and they give up 4.4 yards per rush.
